summary: feat(untappd): venue search, venue get, top-beers, and nearby geosearch
reason: The printed beer/brewery CLI cannot answer near-me / near-hotel questions. Untappd already publishes a venue Algolia index with _geoloc; this novel live surface uses that index plus OSM Photon without the closed official API.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes offline; live nearby --near Elliot Park Hotel Minneapolis returns venues with popularity and null venue ratings
